ValidationRule.description: Show error if Case's Subject is "Account Tier Change", it has no contact, and the Status is changed to Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: /* Show error if Case's Subject is "Account Tier Change", it has no contact, and the Status is changed to Closed. */ AND( ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed"), ISCHANGED(Status), ISBLANK( ContactId ), CONTAINS( Subject , "Account Tier Change") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select Primary Contact for Account
